watch_outs: State Contractor Licensing: Arkansas requires licensing for projects over $20,000 Arkansas Contractors Licensing Board licenses work over $20,000—verify at aclb.arkansas.gov. Roofing contractors have separate licensing requirements.

Humidity & Moisture Control: Arkansas humidity creates year-round moisture challenges High humidity causes mold and moisture issues, especially in crawl spaces. Reddit emphasizes proper ventilation and moisture barriers.
Severe Storms & Tornadoes: Arkansas experiences tornadoes and severe storms Arkansas sees regular severe weather. Reddit recommends safe rooms, wind-rated materials, and proper roof tie-downs.

Termite Prevention: Arkansas has significant termite pressure Subterranean termites are prevalent throughout Arkansas. Reddit strongly recommends pre-treatment, regular inspections, and termite bonds.
Crawl Space Moisture: Crawl spaces in Arkansas are prone to moisture problems Traditional vented crawl spaces struggle with Arkansas humidity. Reddit recommends encapsulation with vapor barriers.
